policy.ambiguity_policy: Keep one best derivation per spelling/canonical pair; retain different canonical readings for the same spelling.
policy.narrowing_from_prototype: Forbid composing alternative onset conventions, including zaa->jaa->yaa. Onset+final combinations such as caa->chaa->cha remain.
policy.tone_policy: Numeric tone1..6 is passed through unchanged; aliases never substitute tones or imply all six tones are attested. Yale diacritics and low-register h are not parsed by this ASCII profile.
policy.yale_ascii: One original-syllable table conversion in forgiving mode, never fed into legacy heuristics. Preserve existing alias costs; new aliases cost 0.45. Every base has a classified route, with explicit Jyutping fallback for unverified rare forms.

rules.evidence: Optional n/l merger; a canonical ng onset is excluded.
Optional ng/zero onset merger; bare syllabic ng is not deleted.
Alternative input convention for the z onset. This is not Jyutping j.
Alternative input convention for the c onset.
Alternative y spelling for a canonical Jyutping j onset; jyu/jyun/jyut retain a single y.
Example-backed typing convenience, including fai for faai. It must not erase the strict mode's aa/a distinction.
Example-aligned convenience, including bo for bou; not a complete scheme conversion.
Inferred from bao in Google's chasiubao example; generalized only within one canonical syllable.
Input spelling tolerance; not a claim that distinct Jyutping finals are identical.
Input spelling tolerance; strict mode keeps eo and oe distinct.
Independent onset/final table lookup from the original canonical syllable; never recursively rewritten. Existing spelling/canonical alias costs are retained.
KFCD numeric-Yale field0 and Jyutping field6 attest these six additional tone-free whole-syllable routes. Primary ew spellings remain; alternates are never fed through merger/onset/vowel rules.

policy.ambiguity_policy: Keep one best derivation per spelling/canonical pair; retain different canonical readings for the same spelling.
policy.narrowing_from_prototype: Forbid composing alternative onset conventions, including zaa->jaa->yaa. Onset+final combinations such as caa->chaa->cha remain.
policy.tone_policy: Numeric tone1..6 is passed through unchanged; aliases never substitute tones or imply all six tones are attested. Yale diacritics and low-register h are not parsed by this ASCII profile.
policy.yale_ascii: One original-syllable table conversion in forgiving mode, never fed into legacy heuristics. Preserve existing alias costs; new aliases cost 0.45. Every base has a classified route, with explicit Jyutping fallback for unverified rare forms.

rules.evidence: Optional n/l merger; a canonical ng onset is excluded.
Optional ng/zero onset merger; bare syllabic ng is not deleted.
Alternative input convention for the z onset. This is not Jyutping j.
Alternative input convention for the c onset.
Alternative y spelling for a canonical Jyutping j onset; jyu/jyun/jyut retain a single y.
Example-backed typing convenience, including fai for faai. It must not erase the strict mode's aa/a distinction.
Example-aligned convenience, including bo for bou; not a complete scheme conversion.
Inferred from bao in Google's chasiubao example; generalized only within one canonical syllable.
Input spelling tolerance; not a claim that distinct Jyutping finals are identical.
Input spelling tolerance; strict mode keeps eo and oe distinct.
Independent onset/final table lookup from the original canonical syllable; never recursively rewritten. Existing spelling/canonical alias costs are retained.
